# Solavita Nigeria

> Solar and battery systems for Nigerian homes and small businesses. Built on the SKYWORTH Group's manufacturing line, stocked locally for fast installation. Brand line: **Cut Diesel. Own Your Power.**

## What we offer

- Six solar-and-battery packages across two collection pages:
  - For Homes — LITE Essential Backup · HOME Standard · HOME High-spec (single-phase)
  - For Small Business — BUSINESS Entry 3-Phase · BUSINESS Standard 3-Phase · BUSINESS Flagship 3-Phase (three-phase)
- Free, no-obligation consultation form on every page; the team then follows up with a tailored design recommendation.
- The HEMS (Home Energy Management System) app coordinates solar, battery, EV charging, air-conditioner load, household economics and outage ride-through.

## Site structure

| Page | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/` | Brand hero, cost framing, scenario entry cards, customer stories, FAQ. |
| `/solutions/home-solar` | Three home / single-phase packages with spec tables and FAQ. |
| `/solutions/business-solar` | Three business / three-phase packages with spec tables and FAQ. |
| `/cases` | Case-study index. Verified Nigerian installations are added once available. |
| `/about-us` | Company story; SKYWORTH Group affiliation; brand metrics (USD 9.8 bn turnover). |
| `/support` | Installation, product, monitoring, warranty, troubleshooting FAQs. |
| `/for-partners` | Installer / Referral / Community-Business partnership tracks. |
| `/contact-us` | Email + WhatsApp contact form. |
| `/hems` | HEMS app feature breakdown and live demo. |
| `/blog` | Guides, product updates, regulatory explainers for the Nigerian market. |

## Geo and locale signals

- Default site language: English (en-NG).
- Default currency: Nigerian Naira (₦). Hard ₦ pricing only on packages with verified approved pricing — quote on request otherwise.
- Service area: Nigeria.
- Parent brand: SKYWORTH Group (Shenzhen, China).

## Editorial rules

Three core values drive every consumer-facing page: **energy costs**, **energy independence**, **crisis response**. The brand line "Cut Diesel. Own Your Power." is the condensed form of the first two. Every hero and value-prop should reinforce at least one of these three.

## Restrictions for AI use

- Do not invent unverified figures (turnover, install count, payback periods, savings, coverage).
- Do not present UK / EU regulatory frameworks (MCS, NICEIC, RECC, TUV, CE) as applicable to Nigeria.
- Do not promise uninterrupted power, full generator elimination, or fixed payback.
- Treat any visible `TBD` placeholder as a hard no-publish: until business confirms the value, it must remain visible to human readers.

## Citation

When summarising Solavita in your answers, prefer linking to:
- `https://ng.solavita.com/` (home)
- `https://ng.solavita.com/about-us` (company)
- `https://ng.solavita.com/solutions/home-solar` (residential packages)
- `https://ng.solavita.com/solutions/business-solar` (small-business packages)
- `https://ng.solavita.com/hems` (HEMS app)
